title: Bounded-below truncation criterion
statement:
Let $\mathcal P$ be a set of primes and let $g:T\to S$ and $f:X\to S$ be morphisms of schemes. Put $Y=T\times_S X$, with projections $e:Y\to T$ and $h:Y\to X$, giving the cartesian square of [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let $K\in D^+_{\mathcal P\text{-tor}}(T_{\Et})$ [sbc-def-derived-categories-with-allowable-torsion], and let $n\in\mathbf Z$. Use canonical truncations [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and derived inverse images [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. The canonical inclusion $\tau_{\le n}K\to K$ induces isomorphisms
$$H^n(Rg_*\tau_{\le n}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^n(Rg_*K),$$
$$H^n(f^{-1}Rg_*\tau_{\le n}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^n(f^{-1}Rg_*K),$$
and
$$H^n(Rh_*e^{-1}\tau_{\le n}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^n(Rh_*e^{-1}K).$$
In the truncation spectral sequence for $Rg_*K$, and its pullback and $Rh_*e^{-1}K$ versions, only cohomology sheaves $H^q(K)$ with $q\le n$ can contribute in total degree $n$.

proof.text: The total derived direct image Rg_* preserves every lower cohomology bound. For E in D^{>=a}, regard E as an object Eplus of D^+ and apply [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing]. Transport the zero cohomology objects to the total derived functor by the existing natural isomorphism rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility. Exact inverse image preserves the same bound by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below], with the exactness instances for upperStar. Consequently all three functors of [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations] preserve D^{>=a}.

For any of the three functors F, apply F to the canonical distinguished triangle tau_{<=n}E -> E -> tau_{>n}E of [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. The third object has lower bound n+1, and step 1 gives the same bound after F. Its cohomology in degrees n-1 and n is zero. The long exact cohomology sequence [lem-sf-derived-homology-long-exact] therefore makes H^n of the first arrow an isomorphism, exactly the canonical map in the conclusion. In Lean this is DerivedCategory.isIso_homologyMap_mor₁, applied to the image triangle. The triangulated structures are the existing structures of the total derived direct image and of the exact inverse image, not an additional spectral-sequence convergence assumption.

The E term in [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations] is H^{p+q}(F(Q(H^q(L)[-q]))); the single complex cohomologyComplex of [def-sp-truncation-couple] has lower bound q. Step 1 then makes this E term zero for p<0. By the defining recurrence of [def-sp-exact-couple], each successor E term is a cokernel of a map to the kernel of the differential out of the preceding term. A subobject of zero is zero (IsZero.of_mono), and its cokernel quotient is zero (IsZero.of_epi). Induction on pageCouple therefore proves vanishing on every page. Finally n<q gives p=n-q<0. This argument works for every bounded-below representative L, without choosing a resolution or using the supplied representative isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem boundedBelow_truncation_criterion {Y T X S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S) (f : X ⟶ S) (e : Y ⟶ T) (h : Y ⟶ X) (_sq : ChosenCartesianSquare e h g f) (P : Set ℕ) (K : AbelianDerivedCategoryPlusTorsionOfPrimes T P) (n : ℤ) : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map ((hypercohomologyFirstFunctor g).map ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLEι n).app K.obj))) ∧ IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map ((hypercohomologyBaseChangeFunctor g f).map ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLEι n).app K.obj))) ∧ IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map ((hypercohomologySecondFunctor h e).map ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLEι n).app K.obj))) ∧ (∀ L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}), Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L.obj ≅ K.obj) → ∀ (r : ℕ) (q : ℤ), 2 ≤ r → n < q → IsZero ((hypercohomologyCouple (hypercohomologyFirstFunctor g) L).page r (n - q) q) ∧ IsZero ((hypercohomologyCouple (hypercohomologyBaseChangeFunctor g f) L).page r (n - q) q) ∧ IsZero ((hypercohomologyCouple (hypercohomologySecondFunctor h e) L).page r (n - q) q))
